method: All 58 original source/extracted PNG files were individually viewed after their own original capture hashes and normalized inventory records were verified.
observations: All eleven native examples and all captured editor tabs render in both source and freshly extracted execution; no blank or substituted scene was observed.

Authored/playing pairs show actual actor pose changes and material progression. The floodable yard shows its tank draining into the floor basin, and the cavern shows falling native granular material. These short phases do not establish sustained emergent behavior.

The Modules tab displays module semantics, numeric units, searchable catalogue, priorities, validation status, Apply/Revert, and live copied diagnostics. The Personality tab visibly says exploration and social drives.

Places and peers presents numeric authored home/interest/avoidance regions and copied-peer relationship guidance; further settings use the existing scroll area. Library and group exposes reusable profiles and Ctrl/Shift group selection.
The dialog, tabs, Apply/Revert controls and inspector remain inside the actual framebuffer. Long profile descriptions can scroll horizontally; the UI is still dense.

Overview actors are small. Model/policy labels do not identify personality, and social/region/intent labels overlap around the selected ground actor. Follow selected remains necessary for comfortable individual observation.
Source and extracted images are compared semantically; independent native progression, status-bar wrapping and draw timing need not produce identical image bytes.

The new source changes the home-rest rule and one help word; scene geometry and profiles remain as previously authored. These graphical receipts do not accept physical NVIDIA or owner monitor playfeel.
